question: REMY is related to VHOZ in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, ZFHU is related to DIJV. To which of the given options is LBSO related, following the same logic?
solution:
Place value and reverse value of letters. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97f83d0bb7111a9e3944d6e8b1f8a569d8dbc491d6ecb218184c59883a4566d9.png] 

Logic followed here is,

For REMY is related to VHOZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8205ca5e3c2c4ff2e2be49950b6525f396abc11cc1419ae0bd94dbf04f969151.png] 

And ZFHU is related to DIJV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e98c9c6548ee1a234a051fa1931fb568144d0a0360ca64a674b231057cd114f9.png] 

Similarly, LBSO is related to PEUP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f56a9025c01d59c6d703f6644f1c79fa47ee293693d6442137a7ba852ba627bc.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 4**"
